diagnostics.message: `aws_autoscaling_group.client_nodes` can be created concurrently with `aws_autoscaling_group.master_nodes`. Client ES nodes may launch before a master quorum exists, causing cluster join/health-check failures. The data ASG already has an explicit dependency on master nodes; the client ASG needs the same operational ordering. There is no attribute reference from the client ASG to the master ASG, so this must be a bare depends_on.

`aws_iam_instance_profile.elasticsearch` only references `aws_iam_role.elasticsearch`, so it can be created before `aws_iam_role_policy.elasticsearch` is attached. The Elasticsearch instances launched via this profile may boot before the EC2 discovery policy is effective and fail to describe instances. Make the instance profile depend on the discovery policy.

`aws_iam_instance_profile.elasticsearch` can be created before `aws_iam_role_policy.asg_discover` is attached. Master-eligible nodes using this profile need the ASG-describe permissions at boot for discovery; if the policy is not yet effective they can fail to discover the cluster. Add the policy ordering to the instance profile.
